title: Locale strings (v0)
description: Per-locale string file (en.json / ca.json / es.json) — the SCENE/TOUR content locale files at locales/{en,ca,es}.json. Flat key-value map keyed by content ID. Every locale file MUST have an identical key set; the inbound validator enforces parity. Tracker generates all three; missing translations show up as either empty strings or missing keys depending on policy (see ADR 0003). For the SEPARATE archives-{locale}.json files (which her loader uses, keyed by filename), see the x-archive-locale-companion section at the bottom of this schema.

^(stop|scene|appendix|character|bibliogr.description: All values are strings. Empty string is permitted and signals 'no translation available'.

x-key-namespaces.comment: Documented separately from JSON Schema validation. Each key uses dot-delimited segments. Producers and consumers should both rely on these prefixes.
x-key-namespaces.scene.<scene_id>.title: Scene heading (e.g. 'EXT. FRONT ENTRANCE OF HOSPITAL - NIGHT').
x-key-namespaces.scene.<scene_id>.beat: Beat description — what's happening in the scene.
x-key-namespaces.scene.<scene_id>.hero.title: Short title for the hero image (~25 chars).
x-key-namespaces.scene.<scene_id>.hero.short_caption: Short caption beneath the hero (~50 chars).
x-key-namespaces.appendix.<appendix_id>.title: Short title for an appendix image (~25 chars).
x-key-namespaces.appendix.<appendix_id>.short_caption: Short caption beneath an appendix image.
x-key-namespaces.character.<character_id>.bio: One-to-two-sentence character bio. Deferred from app v0 launch.
x-key-namespaces.stop.<stop_id>.name: Display name of the stop (e.g. 'Hospital de la Santa Creu').
x-key-namespaces.bibliography.<ref_key>.title: Translated title of a bibliography entry (when applicable).

x-id-conventions.comment: How the IDs in keys are constructed. Producers MUST be stable across publishes.
x-id-conventions.scene_id: Stable integer from the tracker's scenes.id, prefixed nowhere — used raw.
x-id-conventions.id (bibliography): Bibliography id (e.g. 'B1', 'A12') — short, stable, author-chosen. Per ADR 0010 the field is named 'id', not 'ref_key'.

x-archive-locale-companion.comment: The bundle ALSO emits archives-{locale}.json files alongside the main locale files (locales/archives-{en,ca,es}.json) to match Emily's existing iOS loader, which keys archive captions by FILENAME rather than by scene/appendix id. The tracker performs the join (filename → asset → captions) at publish time. Same parity rules apply: identical key set across all three archive-locale files.

shape.comment: Same flat key-value shape as the main locale files, but keys are image filenames.
shape.<filename>.title: Short title for this image (~25 chars).

example.hospital_santa_creu-hero-01.jpg.title: Hospital entrance
example.hospital_santa_creu-hero-01.jpg.short_ca: Where Gaudí spent his final hours

x-archive-locale-companion.note: The main locale files (en.json etc.) continue to carry scene-content keys (scene.<id>.beat, stop.<id>.name, character.<id>.bio, bibliography.<id>.title). Archive image captions live in archives-{locale}.json. This split matches Emily's loader pattern without requiring her to refactor.
